verdict: Organic visibility is contracting; profile and search activity both down.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your account ran entirely on organic activity — no paid ads were in market, so all traffic and profile engagement came through your Google Business Profile and search presence. In the most recent 7 days, Google Business Profile actions dropped 55% versus the prior 7 days, with the last three days showing zero actions; search clicks fell 36% over the same comparison, pointing to a broader visibility contraction rather than an isolated event. Website sessions followed the same direction, down roughly 49% week over week. We're reviewing your profile content and category settings to address the low conversion rate from profile impressions and to recover visibility ahead of the next reporting period. You can expect a clearer picture of whether these changes restore engagement over the next two weeks.
